_comment: Venues Earn may use that are not zap pools. PAXGy has NO on-chain accrual rate (no convertToAssets, no pricePerShare, checked 2026-09-29), so its contribution can only be measured as a price change that mixes the gold price with whatever the issuer accrued. Stored here with the deposit asset's closes beside it so the return can be expressed in SPCXx terms, which is the unit the user deposits and withdraws in. Refresh with scripts/measure_earn_venues.py.
source: OKX 1D klines per token (onchainos market kline)

earn_rwa._comment: The 'RWA Fixed Yield' venue (sarf/xlayer/earn_pendle.py + pendle_rwa.py). USDG's reserves are cash and short-term US Treasury bills (Paxos, attested monthly) and Pendle's own platform tags this exact market 'stables' AND 'rwa' — the label is Pendle's, not Sarf marketing. Principal-protected by construction: only the PROCEEDS (redeemed minus principal, floored at 0) ever buy an RWA, and the user names which RWA at deposit time, validated against the same registry + RWA_ALLOWLIST every other RWA purchase in Sarf goes through. No leverage, no Aave loop — a borrow-and-loop version is negative carry against the base fixed rate and only turns positive via Pendle's own time-limited incentive emissions, which is marketing spend, not a durable yield.
